caption: An elderly man lowers himself into an armchair and sits down.

sa.check: A man stands in front of an armchair.
The lowering comes first and the sitting follows.

pc.expect: He bends at the hips and knees, and his body folds only at the joints.
pc.fail: He folds mid-torso like cloth; or his legs bend mid-shin; or an arm detaches.

pc.expect: He sinks down under his own weight in a controlled way and settles onto the seat.
pc.fail: He floats down slower than a feather; or he rises; or he sinks through the seat.

pc.expect: He sits on the cushion, which compresses under him.
pc.fail: He passes into the chair; or the chair passes through him; or the cushion stays rigid.

pc.expect: He leans forward slightly as he sinks and settles back.
pc.fail: He falls backward over the chair; or tips sideways and hangs; or the chair moves toward him.

pc.expect: His limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb detaches or vanishes; or a second figure appears; or he merges with the chair.

pc.expect: His clothing, the chair and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: His clothing changes colour; or the chair changes; or the room rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
